serantis_battle:*_master_stone: Won by beating a Creature Master. Each stone (up to 5 per influence) makes that influence's creatures appear around you a bit more. Place it to show it off.
serantis_battle:eternita_stone: For all 5 stones of all 12 influences: 5 in 100 wild creatures near you are Mutated. Place it to show it off.
serantis_battle:*_mastery_trophy: Earned for every 10 creatures of one influence you gain. A decorative block: place it.
serantis_battle:magic_staff: Right-click an enchanting table while holding it to link a spell (25 XP). In battle it adds that spell to your moves.
serantis_battle:*_staff: Hold it in either hand in battle to cast its spell as one of your moves.
serantis_battle:backpack: Right-click to wear it. B opens it (36 slots); sneak + B takes it off. A worn backpack is never lost.
serantis_battle:winged_boots: Double-tap jump to fly for 10 seconds; the fall afterwards never hurts. Touch the ground to recharge.
ahrivaea:vessel: Use it on a wild creature to try to catch it straight into your party. Weakened creatures are easier to catch.
ahrivaea:swift_treat: Feed it to a creature you ride to make it faster: the first speed tier.
ahrivaea:golden_treat: Feed it to a creature you ride: the second speed tier.
ahrivaea:racing_treat: Feed it to a creature you ride: the top speed tier.
ahrivaea:swift_feed: Feed it to a horse, donkey or mule: the first speed tier.
ahrivaea:golden_feed: Feed it to a horse, donkey or mule: the second speed tier.
ahrivaea:racing_feed: Feed it to a horse, donkey or mule: the top speed tier.
ahrivaea:stellar_*: Stellar gear: netherite upgraded with a Nether Star at a smithing table.
ahrivaea:base_core: The heart of a base: place it, then right-click to put creatures to work, upgrade it and train your skills.
ahrivaea:mining_post: Place it in your base with a chest beside it: your miners dig out the chunk below.
ahrivaea:creature_dynamo: Gives off a redstone signal while creatures work at your base.
serantis_dyed_water:*_water_bucket: Coloured water: it flows, can be swum in and scooped up like normal water.
